scene: The holographic map unlocks the terminal doors, revealing three new transit routes.
picture: A wide, flat side view of an outdoor transit plaza under purple skies. On the far left, a woven bamboo cable car hangs open. The player in her red bomber jacket and roller skates stands left of centre. In the centre, a paper-lantern balloon bobs gently, and on the far right stands a brass revolving door.
shown: a green bamboo cable car dangling open at the platform on the far left
a glowing paper-lantern hot air balloon moored to a bollard in the centre
a gleaming brass revolving door spinning smoothly set into the far right wall
